title: Judge relief at final render scale: too little is texture, too much is foam
summary: ±.2 m relief didn't read; stronger read as sponge. Final: noise at 2.4/6/14 per m, pits clamped, amp .5, small bumpScale, a raking key, less ambient. Judge at render scale.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: relief(w, h, .5, seed, soil)   // + a raking DirectionalLight nearly along the face

doc.when: Any displaced surface meant to read as rough earth/rock.
doc.avoid: Big bumpScale on top of geometric relief (washes out the geometric normals).
gotchas: Clamp pits: soil settles, it has no holes.

problem.symptom: Earth reads flat, or as a sponge with black voids.
problem.cause: Wrong relief amplitude/frequency for the render scale; bump noise overriding geometry; frontal light.
problem.fix: The tuned noise scales + clamp + small bump + raking key.
problem.detect: Critic words: 'flat', 'sponge', 'foam'; crops at final resolution.
